messages:
annie: quick sync: pulling together an 'edge playbook' for gen API — need to align on scope, launch criteria, and who owns which edge cases (streaming resume, truncation, token-limit retries). can we list top 6 and owners? cc @matt @kevin

matt: SG. i'll do streaming/resume semantics. question: do we require deterministic resume token format or can runtime add opaque token? (customers want cross-retry resume)

kevin: opaque token + server-side mapping is easiest but makes cross-deploy resume hard. we can define a compact resume proto: {cursor, model, seq, checksum} — small overhead, deterministic. :+1:  

olga: SRE ask: any resume token that references server-side KV must have TTL and eviction strategy. otherwise large traffic spikes = memory blowup. propose 1h TTL + LRU + metrics.

sam: for truncation: do we truncate on server or return partial with reason code? Customers prefer partial + explicit 'truncated=true' field so apps can decide to re-request with context window.

matt: agree. acceptance: when truncated we return last_token_index, truncated=true, and a hint: max_tokens_left. also streaming truncation must flush 'truncated' event in stream.

annie: launch criteria draft: (1) streaming resume works end-to-end for 2 clients, (2) truncation visible in both streaming and non-streaming, (3) retry/replay idempotency for up to 3 retries, (4) docs + SDK examples. objections?

kevin: retry idempotency: we need request-id + resume token interplay. propose: client-side idempotency key + server stores lightweight dedup map for 60s. but we should allow 'replay' semantics for up to N tokens.

olga: ops checklist: rollout gate if dedup map memory > 15% or error rate > 0.5%. Also log 'resume-failure' metric.

sam: edge list I have: - streaming cutoff mid-word, - resume after model switch (fallback to smaller model), - truncated top-k discrepancy, - token counts with multibyte chars, - retries with partial delta duplication.

matt: for 'resume after model switch' we should support compatibility mode: resume token includes 'model_version' and runtime can map if compatible; fallback to 'no-resume' and emit event.

annie: ownership: matt -> streaming/resume, kevin->resume token format + dedup, olga->ops/metrics/rollout gates, sam->truncation/retry testcases, annie->docs + launch criteria. sounds good? i'll add to PRD.

kevin: quick spec snippet for PRD (will paste into PRD):
```
response {
  truncated: boolean
  last_token_index: int
  resume_token: string | null
  resume_meta: {model_version: string, checksum: string} | null
}
```

matt: one more: streaming clients need a 'stream-finalization' event that includes final meta (truncated, tokens_consumed, request_id). otherwise clients can't decide to retry.

annie: ok i'll update PRD and create a checklist issue. action items: matt PR with resume tests, kevin schema PR, olga add metrics alarms, sam write test vectors. target: end of next sprint. thanks :rocket:

deploy-bot: noted — doc PR created: /prs/4821 (annie)
